definitions.explanation: Deep faith in the character, ability, or integrity of someone or something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{信頼|しんらい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧。
examples.english: He is highly trusted by his boss.
examples.notes: {信頼|しんらい}が{厚|あつ}い means 'to be deeply trusted'

examples.japanese: {信頼|しんらい}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I consulted with someone I trust.

examples.japanese: {信頼|しんらい}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes time to build a relationship of trust.

notes:
{信頼|しんらい} implies a deeper level of trust than ⟦{信用|しんよう}→信用：03267_shinyou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {信頼|しんらい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to trust, to rely on)
- {信頼|しんらい}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (trustworthy, reliable)
- {信頼|しんらい}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (relationship of trust)
- {信頼|しんらい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{裏切|うらぎ}る→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧ (to betray trust)
- {信頼|しんらい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧ (to be deeply trusted)
- {信頼|しんらい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧ (to place trust in)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {信頼|しんらい}: trust (in character, deeper relationship)
- ⟦{信用|しんよう}→信用：03267_shinyou⟧: trust (more practical, credit-related)
